kurzbeschreibung: The **Stubaital** valley captivates with its year-round accessible **Stubaier Gletscher**, wild and romantic waterfalls, and one of Tirol’s most beautiful mountain lakes.
beschreibung: The **Stubaital** is just 30 kilometers south of Innsbruck and is thus one of the most easily accessible holiday regions in Tirol. The **Stubaier Gletscher** is one of Austria’s largest glacier ski areas and is open from October to June. The **Stubaier Höhenweg** is among the most beautiful multi-day hikes in the Alps. The **Sulzenauhütte** waterfall and the picturesque **Falbesoner See** are popular day-trip destinations.
tipps: Der Stubaier Höhenweg erfordert Schwindelfreiheit – aber es gibt kürzere Alternativen wie die Elfer-Nordkette.
Der Parkplatz am Stubaier Gletscher ist vor allem in der Sommersaison schnell voll – früh anreisen!
Der Milser Weiher ist ein Naturbadesee mit Strandbad und Liegewiese.
empfehlungen: A must: the ride on the Eisgratbahn up to 2,900 meters to enjoy the panoramic walk on the **Stubaier Gletscher**. Afterwards, head to the Naturhotel Stubai in Neustift for an authentic Tiroler **Brettljause**.
umgebung: The **Stubaital** borders **Innsbruck** to the north and **Südtirol** (Italy) to the south. The **Stubaier Alpen** are separated from the **Ötztaler Alpen** by the main Alpine ridge. Neighboring valleys include the **Sellraintal** (west) and **Wipptal** (east). The **Brennerpass** serves as a key north-south route.
